implementation_design_preflight.current_flow: Platform input normalizes into PointerSample; Interaction owns sessions; OperationEngine validates and commits canonical operations; Snapshot/Replay use the same semantic validators; Scene/Render derive view state; hosts and Debug UI remain thin clients.
implementation_design_preflight.i1_owner: runtime/semantic validator, protobuf mapping, snapshot bootstrap and replay; no second semantic store
implementation_design_preflight.prepare: validate exact Shape/2 tuple and required scalar presence before any store/generation mutation
implementation_design_preflight.commit: reuse OperationEngine atomic prepare/apply and existing generation/ledger/clock
implementation_design_preflight.publication: reuse existing canonical commit/readback path; no publication for rejected input
implementation_design_preflight.abort: reject whole operation or leave replay Loading/Failed according to existing Snapshot/Replay contracts; no partial store mutation
